name: rocket-arena
description: Authoritative browser multiplayer car-ball game, 3v3 Quick Match and up to 4v4 Custom Rooms (Rocket League-style)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: tsc -b shared simulation && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.test:physics: tsx --conditions=development server/src/physics/test-ball.ts && tsx --conditions=development server/src/physics/test-car.ts && tsx --conditions=development server/src/physics/test-controller.ts && tsx --conditions=development server/src/physics/test-goal-tunnel.ts && tsx --conditions=development server/src/physics/test-grounding.ts && tsx --conditions=development server/src/physics/test-impact.ts && tsx --conditions=development server/src/physics/test-jump-sequence.ts
scripts.dev:lab: concurrently -k -n server,client "env NODE_ENV=production ROCKET_ARENA_DEV_CONTROLS=false npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.lab: concurrently -k -n server,client "env NODE_ENV=production ROCKET_ARENA_DEV_CONTROLS=false npm run start -w server" "npm run preview -w client"
